test_cases.action: Open the page that has your own name as its big heading: tap your name at the bottom-left of the column of rooms, beside the round picture. Scroll the page down and back up. Then look away for a few seconds, look back, and say, from the top of the screen only, which page you are on. Leave with the X at the top-left.
test_cases.real_if: at every scroll position nothing at the top names the page
test_cases.not_real_if: a page name appears somewhere as you scroll, or you can say which page it is from the top alone
test_cases.observed_result: I tapped my name, "Accessibility Testing", at the bottom of the column, and a page slid up. At the top there is only an X on a black band, then my round picture, then a bubble that now says "Favorite NPC companion?". That is a third different phrase after "Can't wait for..." and "Shower thought?". Below that are my name, "Edit Profile", and the tabs Main and Wishlist. I scrolled down: the X and the black band went off the top and my name moved up. I scrolled back up. At no scroll position does any word name the page. There is no "Profile" and no "Your profile". After looking away and back, the top of the screen alone only told me "there is a close button". I worked out that it is my profile from my own name and the Edit Profile button, as before. The X closed it and returned me to the server channel list.

s22.closing_comment: No page name at any scroll position. The only place label is my own name, which names a person, not a page. A plain title such as "Your profile" would fix it.

test_cases.action: Open the 'general' room (tap an 'ATs' square, then '# general'). Tap the magnifying glass at the top-right. Type the word hello and nothing else. Look away for a few seconds, look back, and say where you are. Leave with the back arrow.
test_cases.real_if: nothing on the screen tells you that you are searching, and in which room
test_cases.not_real_if: you can say from the screen that you are searching, and where
test_cases.observed_result: In #general I tapped the magnifying glass. The screen changed to a search field holding a grey chip "in: general", with the tabs Members, Media, Pins, Threads, Links and Files under it. I typed hello. The tabs disappeared and the field then read "in: general hello", with the message "We searched far and wide. Unfortunately, no results were found." in the middle. After looking away and back I could say it: I am searching for hello inside the general channel. The magnifying glass and the "in: general" chip stayed in the field the whole time, so the room did not get lost. The word "Search" still appears nowhere, and "We searched far and wide" is a figure of speech where "No results" would do. The back arrow returned me to #general.

s32.closing_comment: Once I typed, the "in: general" chip and the magnifying glass stayed and the results area changed, so I could say I was searching in general. It is still carried only by text inside the field; a literal title like "Search in #general" would remove the guesswork.
